raw_definitions: Definisi : 3. (esp liter.) s putih spt kapas: ~ (white) shirts, kemeja yg putih spt kapas. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. covered with snow, dilitupi /salji, salju/: ~ rooftops, bahagian atas bumbung yg dilitupi salji; the ~ peak of Mount Fuji, puncak Gunung Fuji yg dilitupi salji; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj 1. with snow falling, (rel to place), /salji, salju/ turun dgn banyaknya; (rel to weather), /bersalji, bersalju/: a few days ago it was ~ in the northern part of the country, beberapa hari yg lalu, salji turun dgn banyaknya di kawasan utara negeri itu; he came home one ~ day in late December, dia pulang pd satu hari yg bersalji dlm bulan Disember; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
